title: (Education for Exultation) One Generation Shall Praise Your Works to Another
description: In this sermon, the speaker focuses on verse 4 of a biblical passage, which emphasizes the duty of the older generation to pass on the knowledge of God's mighty works to the younger generation. The speaker highlights the importance of teaching, preaching, and modeling the faith to ensure that the younger generation learns how to read, think, trust, obey, and rejoice in God. While the relationship with God should be primary for the older generation, it is crucial for them to transmit their knowledge and faith to the next generation. The speaker also mentions the need to prioritize spiritual matters over worldly distractions and comforts, urging the audience to be aware of the lost souls and unreached people groups who need Christ.
